content: InstancedMesh dynamic updates in r185: setMatrixAt(i, matrix) then instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true each frame; call instanceMatrix.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage) once at setup for per-frame streams. Optional per-instance color via setColorAt + instanceColor.needsUpdate. Reduce visible count with mesh.count. No deprecations; same API the project's grass field already uses.
